events.title: Artist in Residence: Sachém Parkin-Owens
events.location: Museum of Brisbane, King George Square (Brisbane City Hall)
events.description: Martin Edge is a Queensland artist whose playful works capture moments from his everyday life, including both real and imagined adventures. For his Artist in Residence project at Museum of Brisbane, Edge will transform the walls of the Fairfax Gallery with a large-scale mural created over three weeks. Visitors are invited to watch and engage with the artist as the work unfolds, offering a rare insight into his creative process.

events.title: Stories You Wear: Magpie Goose
events.location: Museum of Brisbane, King George Square (Brisbane City Hall)
events.description: This exhibition Stories You Wear: Magpie Goose is a exhibition in collaborate with Magpie Goose, a proudly Aboriginal owned and led fashion and social enterprise, to celebrate extraordinary First Peoples cultural stories and designs. This exclusive to Brisbane exhibition offers a deep dive into the work of some of the region’s most talented First Peoples artists and designers. Using clothing as a canvas for storytelling, this exciting collaboration will connect audiences with the rich and diverse cultural expressions of First Peoples communities in Queensland and beyond.

events.title: Perspectives of Brisbane
events.location: Museum of Brisbane, King George Square (Brisbane City Hall)
events.description: Perspectives of Brisbane is a compelling snapshot of Brisbane’s history, our city's milestone moments and the unique culture of our creative and connected city.
